decisions.reason: GA4 is the current analytics standard and the option has favorable resolution, so it is kept with low drop probability.
Universal Analytics has been discontinued, so the option has no remaining value and should be abandoned.
The retail interface plugin's prospects are still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so the option remains open.
The shop relaunch SEO support service has its own page and likely demonstrated value, so it is kept with little reason to drop.
The SEO workshops are a recent option with uncertain demand, and as long as keeping them on the market is inexpensive the option remains open.
